svg.title: 0 ≤j ≤300, in [−1, 1], and their Lagrange polynomials Lj. If w has moment price η at radius q, let cj = P t wtLj(t) and w0 = P j cjδrj. The coefficient bounds of these finitely many polynomials give P j |cj| ≤Cqη for one fixed Cq ≥0. Every polynomial of degree at most 300 is interpolated exactly, so w −w0 annihilates its moments through that degree. If V ≥q, its remaining moment prices at radius V are bounded by η(1 + Cq)(q/V )301: factor (q/V )n from the degree-n moment and use n ≥301.
